problem: The reviewed wornArmorWeight rule had no production caller. Player/NPC movement used full item weight despite armor mastery.

implementation.policy: Read live equipment and native base skill, with winning mastery/weight settings. Discount only one worn instance; preserve spare counts, item definition weight, condition, ownership and inventory/save metadata. Unworn items receive full weight; TES3 actor path unchanged.

fixture.base_skill_authoring: Synchronize native actor values, native shared Player base entries and legacy base projections. All movement/contact/resource/effect outcomes remain unauthored. Initial derived encumbrance is rebuilt from live inventory; exact fresh proofs use actual captured saves.
fixture.other_player_items: Retain all source items; old body clothing stays in inventory unequipped. Sword remains condition50; no attack actions.
fixture.sanitizer_npc: Pairwise variation: replace worn FurBoots by healthy IronBoots; LightArmor100/HeavyArmor100. Same Player outfit and movement/restart protocol.

normal_input.initial: Load valid initial source; focus, F draw, shared approach/camera/worn guards; actual F5 baseline save.

movement.terminal: Actual F5 save and capture; no contacts or effects.

normal_input.fresh: Actual before-move save -> new D movement; actual after-move save -> A return along prior traversed corridor. Each fresh process first saves its restored baseline, then moves and saves. Exact whole-source restore required.
normal_input.movement_bounds: Horizontal displacement >5 and <200 world units; vertical difference <3. No equal trajectory/timestep or achieved FPS claim.

expected.basis: Only worn FurHelmet1+Cuirass5 become weightless at Light75; worn IronBoots9 becomes4.5 at Heavy75. Spare cuirass5/two boots18 remain full weight. Total discount10.5.

normal_npc.basis: All worn Fur weight11.5 becomes zero at Light100; unrelated inventory remains full weight.

sanitizer_npc.basis: Worn mixed armor19 becomes zero at Light/Heavy100; unrelated inventory remains full weight.

expected.ownership: Complete inventory item dictionaries compare as multisets; every item/count/condition/slot/owner field strict. No contact ledger, RNG, Health, active effect, force or dropped item changes.

verification.focused_scope: Player/NPC below/at/above75/100, mixed worn/unworn, spare copies, base versus modified skill, winning setting and foreign-profile boundaries. Existing component rule coverage reused.
verification.integration: Full2080engine plus current game in each normal/SAN build; one coherent checkpoint because movement owner changed.
verification.runtime_checker: Existing combined-mastery run.py/inspect.py/compare-pair.py with burden profile/flags; no new harness.
